organiser.name: Leah Luna, Stephen McDowell (The Buzzy Kiwi), Stephen Blase, Loren Honey and Lunar Landing (named as the organisers by festival crew)

audience.psychographics: Conscious-living and wellness crowd: breathwork, somatic and ecstatic dance, organic and afro house DJs, healing workshops and ancestral-healing family programming, with te ao Māori and tikanga woven through. Models itself on BaliSpirit Festival and Prana Fest Australia (named as sister festivals).
